question: Can the sealed V2 candidates be correctly classified by generation recipe plus observed graph properties, yielding the frozen 100-parent split without regenerating topology?
reason_now: V2 generated and replayed 120/120 candidates but failed at 99 retained solely because connector count was incorrectly treated as exact graph cycle rank. Cano grown tunnels can create additional cycles through existing intersections.

method.validity: Require generation success, exact replay, requested tunnel counts, connected finite graph/splines, >=300 m length, flat/3D vertical contract, predecessor and duplicate exclusion, and actual cycle_rank >= requested connector count. Record actual cycle rank as GT metadata; do not require equality.
method.selection: Within each recipe stratum select frozen candidate IDs C01 through C10, independent of observed cycle rank.
method.split: Ranks C01-C08 train, C09 validation, C10 development_test in each recipe stratum.
method.visualization: No new rendering. Reference only the ten already reviewed V2 rank-1 train maps. Do not open validation or development-test maps.

claim_boundary: Corrects topology-source metadata and split only. It does not turn graph/splines into a formal perception dataset and authorizes no mesh, LiDAR, label, training, model or M-TARE change.

estimated_cost.compute: Read-only CPU JSON/hash audit; no Cano generation, mesh, raycasting, simulator or training.

approval.confirmation_reference: User replied 继续干 after receiving the exact zero-generation, read-only recipe-reclassification, fixed C01-C10, 100-parent/80-10-10 and zero mesh/LiDAR/training V2R scope.
